newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: ROOIBERG TO BUY S.AFRICAN COPPER-ZINC MINE.
newsitem.headline: ROOIBERG TO BUY S.AFRICAN COPPER-ZINC MINE.

text.p: Maranda Mining Co (Pty) Ltd said on Thursday its shareholders had accepted an offer by Rooiberg Tin Ltd for 84 million rand, to be settled by the issue of 29.05 million Rooiberg shares.
The deal is subject to various approvals, including those of Rooiberg shareholders, the Johannesburg Stock Exchange and the Securities Regulation Panel.

Maranda is a high-grade, profitable junior copper-zinc mine near Gravelotte in South Africa's Northern Province which has been mined since 1991 under the management of junior mining group Metorex. The mine accounts for 15 percent of South African zinc production.
